name: Shay Banon
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2025); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Shay Banon is a cofounder and the former CEO of search engine company Elastic, which is based in Mountain View, California.
Banon stepped down as CEO in 2022. He now serves as chief technology officer of Elastic.
Banon helped to develop the search technology that Elastic uses and became CEO of the company in 2017.
An Israeli citizen, Banon received his B.Sc. in Computer Science from Technion, Israel Institute of Technology.
His fortune derives from his nearly 6% stake in the company, which launched in 2012 and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2018.

name: Alvaro Saieh Bendeck
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2013-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2023)
forbes_bio: Alvaro Saeih Bendeck is the largest shareholder of Itau CorpBanca, a Chilean financial firm, and VivoCorp, a real estate group with malls and offices.
He built CorpBanca after buying Chile's Banco Concepcion in 1995.
Saieh Bendeck sold his stake in insurance companies CorpSeguros and CorpVida in 2016.
He also owns over half of SMU, a Chilean supermarket chain that went public in January 2017.
Born in Colombia, Saieh Bendeck is a Chilean citizen of Palestinian descent.
forbes_facts: Saieh Bendeck owns what was formerly called the Grand Hyatt Santiago, which reopened in 2018 as a Mandarin Oriental hotel.

name: Vincent Tan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2010-2015); Hurun Global (2014-2016)
forbes_bio: Vincent Tan relinquished his position as a non-independent, non-executive chairman of Berjaya Corp as of March 1, 2023. He is now an advisor to the board.
His son Robin Tan relinquished the CEO position in March 2021 but continues as nonexecutive deputy chairman.
Tan's business interests range from financial services to property development.
He also holds a stake in privately held U Mobile, a 4G mobile-phone operator in Malaysia.
Listed flagship Berjaya's CEO Jalil Rasheed. who was appointed in March 2021, left after a year to pursue other interests.
forbes_facts: Vincent Tan retired from conglomerate Berjaya's board in 2012 upon turning 60, but returned as executive chairman five years later.
He started his career as a bank clerk when he was 17 years old.
He went on to become a life insurance agent and eventually bagged the McDonald's franchise for Malaysia in 1980.
His brother Danny Tan also features among Malaysia's richest. He, too, returned from retirement to helm his real estate flagship, Tropicana Corp.

name: Norman Asbjornson
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Norman Asbjornson founded HVAC company AAON in 1988 and took it public three years later.
He served as CEO until 2020, when he transitioned to executive chairman. He retired from that role in 2022 but remains on the board of directors.
AAON reported revenue of $1.2 billion in 2024.
A Montana native, Asbjornson pledged $50 million to help fund a new College of Engineering at his alma mater, Montana State University, in 2014.
Asbjornson is a U.S. Army veteran who served in South Korea.

name: Hang Hong
forbes_bio: Hang Hong is a director of Wuxi Shangji Automation, a supplier of precision equipment for the photovoltaics industry.
Hang Hong cofounded Shangji with husband Yang Jianliang in 2002 and is a director now.
Husband Ynag Jianliang is chairman and president of Wuxi Shangji Automation.

name: Cho Young-sik
forbes_bio: Cho Young-sik is the founder of SD Biosensor, which is best-known for its rapid Covid-19 test called Standard Q.
SD Biosensor listed on the Korea Exchange in July 2021, raising some $680 million.
In late 2020, the Slovakian government bought 13 million Covid-19 tests from SD Biosensor, enough to test its entire population twice over.
Before the pandemic, SD Biosensor made most of its money from blood glucose monitoring devices.
forbes_facts: Actor Song Joong-ki is the company's brand ambassador.
